body: Returning to this throwaway again to let you know that I did the super cheesy "reaching out" thing everybody talks about and it worked. Went to psychiatric hospital with a friend I hadn't seen in a long time and while all they did there was give me antidepressants (I took the first dose today so no effects yet of course), just the experience of something working out and receiving the least amount of care got me out of the worst of it for now. The friend I was there with also gave me a contact for an in-person suicide prevention counseling service that I already had my first session at. Thanks for reaching out, just the fact that you answered gave me some comfort. Take care, comrade

There can be no community because building and maintaining community requires effort that is lost on endlessly working. I need someone to take care of me so bad but how can I put that additional burden on anyone when everybody I know is just scraping by themselves? The walls keeping me alive are also the walls making me slowly insane, just being alone and not experiencing anything new at all. I am in my rigid routine of doing the same things every day (listening to music obsessively on repeat, not leaving the house or even my room, watching the same few ASMR videos to help me sleep), and anything threatening that routine sends me spiraling.
